Integrated BioPharma Reports Results for its Quarter Ended September 30, 2026

 

HILLSIDE, NEW JERSEY (November 13, 2026) - Integrated BioPharma, Inc. (OTCQX: INBP) (the “Company” or “INBP”) reports its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

 

Revenue for the quarters ended September 30, 2026 was $9.9 million compared to $12.7 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, a decrease of $2.8 million or approximately 22.0%. The Company had an operating loss of $1.0 million in the quarter ended September 30, 2026 compared to operating income of $0.2 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2025.

 

For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Company had a net loss of approximately $0.7 million compared to net income of approximately $0.1 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2025 or $(0.02) and $0.00 per share of common stock, respectively. The Company’s diluted net (loss) income per share of common stock for the quarters ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 were $(0.02) and $0.00 per share of common stock, respectively.

 

“Our revenue decreased by approximately 22% in the quarter ended September 30, 2026 from the quarter ended September 30, 2025 and our revenue from our two largest customers in our Contract Manufacturing Segment represented approximately 88% and 87% of total revenue in the quarters ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively,” stated the Co-Chief Executive Officers of the Company, Riva Sheppard and Christina Kay.

About Integrated BioPharma Inc. (INBP)

 

Integrated BioPharma, Inc. (“INBP”) is engaged primarily in the business of manufacturing, distributing, marketing and sales of vitamins, nutritional supplements and herbal products. Further information is available at ir.ibiopharma.com.
